result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: horizontal overflow/cut-off content in both the category filter section and the restaurant cards carousel, which creates poor visual presentation and potential usability confusion.

issues.description: Category filter buttons are horizontally cut off - there appears to be another filter button (partially visible) to the right of 'Healthy' that is not fully displayed
issues.suggestion: Either use horizontal scroll indicators, implement proper overflow handling with visible scroll hints, or adjust button sizes/spacing to fit all visible categories within the viewport

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is cut off on the right side of the screen, appearing truncated both visually and in text
issues.suggestion: Implement visible carousel controls (dots/arrows) to indicate scrollable content, or redesign the grid to show complete cards. Add clear visual indicators that more content is available
